title: Consented directory member
description: A record the member supplies about themselves (spec section 17). There is deliberately no field for a phone number, a home or street address, private messages, or any inferred sensitive trait (health, religion, ethnicity, sexual orientation, political views, biometrics, union membership). additionalProperties is false so none can be added without a schema change and review.

member_id.description: Opaque identifier. Never derived from email or name.

display_name.description: Real name or alias, the member's choice.

verified.description: True only after work-email magic-link verification.

seniority_band.description: Broad band only, never a title ladder level.

city.description: City-level location. Never a street, district, or postcode.

languages.description: BCP 47 language tags, e.g. vi, en-US.

help_topics.description: Topics the member is willing to help with (referrals, resume review, ...).

published_handles.description: Only the handles the member chooses to publish.

last_confirmed.description: Last date the member confirmed this record is current. Stale records are hidden.

response_indicator.description: Rolling indicator computed from the last 90 days; no message content is stored.

consent_log_ref.description: Points at the member's append-only consent log (consent.schema.json).
